45296.summary: The class introduces the concept of Christ's parables in relation to the last days of Judah's commonwealth, focusing on the period from John the Baptist to AD 70. It emphasizes the significance of the kingdom of heaven being at hand and the impending judgment on Jerusalem.

45297.summary: The class explores the parable of the fig tree in Luke 13 and Matthew 21, linking it to the destruction of Jerusalem in AD 70 and the future restoration of Israel. It emphasizes the symbolism of the fig tree representing Israel and the consequences of spiritual barrenness.

45298.summary: The class explores the Parable of the Unjust Judge, highlighting the persecution faced by early Christians from Jewish leaders and the impending destruction of Jerusalem in AD 70. It emphasizes the importance of persistent prayer and endurance in the face of tribulation.

45299.summary: The class explores the Olivet Prophecy, focusing on its fulfillment in AD 70 and its roots in Old Testament prophecies, particularly Daniel. It emphasizes the importance of understanding the historical context and the clear fulfillment of Christ's warnings to his disciples.

45300.summary: The class discusses the Parable of the Householder from Matthew 21, emphasizing Christ's message to the Jews about the kingdom of God and the consequences of rejecting it. It highlights the judgment on the Jewish leadership and the eventual fulfillment of prophecies in AD 70.
